[SWS_LinTrcv_00066]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Lin_01514, SRS_Lin_01563
⌈Wakeup notification must be supported by LIN Transceiver driver, therefore LIN
transceiver driver covers 2 wakeup modes, internal wakeup by an upper layer or exter-
nal wakeup by LIN channel.⌋
1. Internal wakeup: An internal wakeup is initiated by an upper layer, e.g. by calling
LinTrcv_Init or LinTrcv_SetOpMode.
2. External wakeup: Wakeup detected by LIN transceiver driver is forwarded to the
upper layer through the API LinTrcv_CheckWakeup which has to be called by
the LinIf.
Hint: WakeUp through ISR is not supported by the LIN Transceiver Driver but is only
possible through ICU.
